description: Split Persian text into sentences, handling the Persian question mark ؟, the exclamation mark, ellipsis … and abbreviation boundaries. Use it to chunk Persian text for summarization, translation or per-sentence processing. Returns the list of sentences. ($0.005 per call, USDC on Base)
